name: module
title: Thin RP2040 module
orientation: A circuit board, made by a fab (JLCPCB), not printed. Seen from above: USB-C on the top long edge, castellated pins along the bottom edge and up both ends. Parts on the front, test points on the back.

edge_pins.rule: Pins along the bottom long edge, between the corners
edge_pins.label: Long-edge pins

end_pins.rule: Pins up each short end, from the bottom edge (Sea-Picro has 31 edge pins: edge_pins + 2 × end_pins)
end_pins.label: End pins

end_from.rule: The end pins start this many pitches above the bottom edge: at one, the corner pins' header pads would overlap

pitch.rule: Pin pitch: 0.1 in headers, as Sea-Picro's

length.rule: Board length: the long-edge pins one pitch apart, a pitch from each corner
length.label: Length

top_room.rule: From the top end pins to the top edge

height.rule: Board height, bottom edge to top edge
height.label: Height

core_turn.rule: Sea-Picro's core (the RP2040, flash, crystal, regulator and their small parts) turned as one block: its busiest side of escapes (RP2040 pins 2 to 12) faces the long row of pins

core_x.rule: The core block moved along the board: a 2 mm channel from the end pins for tracks to pass

core_y.rule: The core block moved up: clear of the bottom pins, with room above it for tracks

usb_x.rule: USB-C socket along the top edge, from the middle: right of the core, its fuse and CC resistors under it
usb_x.label: USB-C position

usb_out.rule: The mid-mount socket's centre beyond the top edge, as on Sea-Picro

led_x.rule: Pad 32 (LED_5V, a 5 V supply for LEDs) under the USB parts

switch_in.rule: R4 (SWITCH's resistor) in from its pin's castellated hole: clear of the header pad, within its placement rule

layers.rule: Copper layers, as Sea-Picro's: tracks outside, GND and 3.3 V planes inside

track.rule: Signal track width: over JLCPCB's minimum, as Sea-Picro's fine tracks
